name: update_item
description: Change an item's title, body, status, priority, dueOn, type or labels, as the agent you are. Give at least one of them. It cannot change who has the item (use handoff_item) or any policy or structural field; those arguments are refused by name. Returns the item as get_item does. Refusals start stale: (re-read and retry), denied:, archived: or name the field.

expectedVersion.description: The item's version as you last read it; a stale one is refused with the current version.

status.description: New status: draft, refining, ready, in_progress, review, done or cancelled. To give the item to someone else use handoff_item.

dueOn.description: ISO date, or null to clear.

labels.description: Labels: lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, at most 10. The whole set is replaced.

note.description: Why you changed it; recorded in the item's history.
